summary: General Motors Financial Company, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a public offering of $1 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.100% senior notes due 2031. The notes were sold under a shelf registration statement on Form S-3. Net proceeds of approximately $993 million will be added to general funds for corporate purposes. Terms include an underwriting agreement with several underwriters, standard indemnification, and the notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior debt. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
